issues.detail: All threads fall below the minimum required message count of 15 and their respective blueprint target_messages_range. TH1 has 12 messages, TH2 has 11, TH3 has 13, TH4 has 11, and TH5 has 10.
The forbidden term 'performance' appears in the text of messages M44 and M45. Furthermore, explicit level labels 'high' and 'medium' are used in messages M3 and M49.
Message M47 contains 'D7' in its artifact_refs list, which is a decision ID rather than a valid artifact (A*) or task (T*) ID.
